requirements.requirement: Louvred vent so board inside can breathe

finish.summary: Single-cell closed hex enclosure: full base, full top cover, six side caps seal perimeter, one hex-port-louvre provides vented breathing. PSU prop on top shows scale/purpose; caps/joints locked.
